We at times take our hair for granted, assuming it’ll always be there. But as we age, or when complications arise, the rate of hair growth slows down, and our precious locks can take a major hit. Hair loss will affect most of us within our life time, whether it be influenced by age, disease, or other factors.

Many men and women who undergo hair loss might look towards hair transplants to help them in attaining a full head of hair, but a new product on the market right now might be better for those who suffer from alopecia. Kiierr Laser Hair Caps are the future of hair recovery, providing you with an alternative way to healthy, strong, growing hair. Below is a small guide in helping you choose between hair transplants vs. Kiierr to find the right fit for your needs.

What are Hair Transplants?

Hair transplants are type of surgery that moves existing hair onto the area of your head that needs to be filled due to thinning or balding. The procedure normally lasts between 6-9 hours, and can be done by using two methods.

Before choosing the method, the surgeon first cleans the scalp and injects medicine to numb the back of your head, and then either chooses follicular unit strip surgery (FUSS) or follicular unit extraction (FUE).

FUSS works by removing a 6-10 inch strip of skin from the back of your head, which the doctor will set aside and sew the scalp closed. They will then divide the strip of removed scalp into 500 to 2000 tiny grafts, each one containing either an individual hair or just a few. The graft’s number and type depend entirely on your hair type, the quality, color, and size of area where the transplant is occurring.

The FUE procedure is done by shaving the back of your scalp, and then removing hair follicles one by one from there. The area will heal with small dots, which your existing hair will cover.

Both procedures will proceed the same afterwards, where the surgeon will clean and numb the area where the hair will go, create holes or slits, and then will place each graft into the holes or slits.

Due to this process being invasive, most return to work after 2-5 days, and will need to take pain medications for several days, along with bandages over your scalp.

Hair transplants are not only invasive, but costly with major risks you should be aware of. The price generally depends on how large the amount of hair you’re moving, but ranges between $4,000-$15,000, and unfortunately insurance doesn’t cover this cost.

The risks can include bleeding and infection, as well as scarring and unnatural-looking new hair growth. There’s also a risk of losing the original hair in the area where the new strands were put in.

With the surgery being costly and invasive, the risks don’t seem to be worth it for many.

What is Kiierr?

The Kiierr Laser Hair Cap is a product you can do in the comfort of your own home. It does not require laser hair transplants (non invasive), it’s cost effective, and has no risks to your health or to your hair.

 

And did I mention, you can do it at home!

Kiierr Laser Caps improves cellular respiration and stimulates hair follicles by using low-level light therapy, which is scientifically proven to produce thicker and healthier hair. This technology regenerates your hair follicles, giving them increased energy and blood flow.

The product uses low-level light therapy, which refers to a therapy that uses laser or light energy below a specific energy threshold and within a specific wavelength. It produces no heat so the user cannot be burned or injured. LLLT absorbs into the cells, triggering enhanced cellular activity, which then energizes aging cells and stimulates the production of hair.

After receiving your cap, you just place the device on your head, push the ‘on’ button, and begin your session. The device automatically turns off when finished, which will be after 30 minutes. The sessions are done every other day, lasting a period of around four to six months. It is suggested to continue sessions once or twice a week after the initial treatment to maintain your hair quality.

The best part of Kiierr Laser Hair Caps is that it’s all natural.
It’s not only effective (many seeing visible hair growth within months, and see thicker, fuller, and healthier hair as they use it for a period of time), but it’s very safe!

Direct eye contact should be avoided, but no risks or side effects have been identified. It has also been recognized as safe by worldwide governing medical bodies, and meets safety guidelines both by the United States and many foreign governments.

Unfortunately, Kiierr will not work for those suffering from complete baldness, but for those going through other types of hair loss such as androgenic alopecia (male/female pattern balding), telogen effluvium, and other types of hair losses that don’t result in a permanent loss of hair, Kiierr might be best for you compared to other methods.

What is Best For You?

Of course the decision to either undergo hair transplant surgery or Kiierr’s product is up to you and what you think is the best fit to treat your hair loss. However, due to the invasive nature and major risks of hair transplant surgery, trying other methods first, like Kiierr Laser Hair Caps, wouldn’t hurt. For a fraction of the cost, no risks or adverse effect to your health, and being able to do it in the comfort of your home, what’s there to lose?
